name: FCC Dataset Indexing Scheme
definition: An indexing scheme to store an FCC dataset as a four-channel (RGBA) 3D texture to circumvent the lack of hardware support for non-Cartesian volume datasets, avoiding the overhead of shifting layers or loading separate textures.
summary: The FCC Dataset Indexing Scheme stores Face-Centered Cubic volume data in four-channel 3D textures, halving memory usage compared to naive storage while enabling GPU compatibility.
